description: This file contains the implementation of a Kinesis record processor for Spark Streaming, including the class 'KinesisRecordProcessor' which handles record processing, checkpointing, and lease management, as well as a companion object with a retry mechanism.

classes.name: KinesisRecordProcessor
classes.description: A class implementing the ShardRecordProcessor interface to process Kinesis stream records, handle checkpointing, and manage shard lifecycle events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the processor with shard ID and logs the initialization.

methods.name: processRecords
methods.description: Processes a batch of records from Kinesis, adds them to Spark receiver, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: leaseLost
methods.description: Handles the loss of a shard lease and removes the checkpointer.

methods.name: shardEnded
methods.description: Handles the end of a shard, performs checkpointing.

methods.name: shutdownRequested
methods.description: Handles shutdown requests and removes checkpointer.

methods.name: retryRandom
methods.description: Retries a given expression multiple times with random backoff, handling specific exceptions.
